title: Zapier z.request throws on every 4xx before your code can read the error body
symptoms: ResponseError thrown from z.request for a 4xx status
Custom error parsing after z.request never runs
Upgrading an old integration to core 10 or later changes error messages
cause: Since core 10.0.0 z.request calls throwForStatus on every response of 400 or more before returning it, unless skipThrowForStatus is set.
fix: Set skipThrowForStatus on requests where you need the body, then throw a z.errors.Error with a readable message.
apply:
const res = await z.request({ url, method: 'POST', body, skipThrowForStatus: true });
if (res.status >= 400) throw new z.errors.Error(res.json.message, 'ApiError', res.status);
